subject: Mediflow — Clarify customer-scoped debug log lifecycle
messages:
From: John Smith <j.smith@mediflow.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: privacy@mediflow.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mediflow — Clarify customer-scoped debug log lifecycle

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this — our InfoSec team is reviewing Redwood for an upcoming procurement. A couple of items came up in the SIG/CAIQ review that I wanted to confirm before we move to legal.

Short summary of asks:
- We need clarity on session/debug trace retention for customer tenants (SIG item: logging/forensics). Our standard expectation is 180 days for debug traces related to clinical workflows; I see Redwood defaults to 30 days in hosted mode.
- If a customer requests a longer TTL (e.g., 180d), what operational and cryptographic controls does Redwood require/offer (key custody, immutable deletion attestations, segmented retention by tenant)?
- What artefacts can Redwood provide as evidence for SOC 2 / auditor requests that a specific tenant's debug traces were disposed of according to agreed TTLs (proof-of-delete, export of deletion audit trail, sample retention matrix)?

Can you outline options and what a customer-facing addendum would look like (we anticipate attaching a short SOW/addendum to the contract)? Also—do you have a CAIQ mapping doc we can hand to our auditor that shows the controls and where the evidence lives?

Appreciate a short reply and potential next steps.

Best,
John
John Smith
Head of InfoSec | Mediflow Health
privacy@mediflow.com
+1 415 555 0123
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: John Smith <j.smith@mediflow.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mediflow — Clarify customer-scoped debug log lifecycle

Hi John — thanks for the clear summary. Looping Neha (security operations) and Jonas (platform infra) so we can scope a concrete response and list of deliverables.

High-level options we can offer:
1) Hosted standard: 30-day TTL for ephemeral debug/session traces (default, no additional fee). Evidence: retention config export + per-token latency/cost logs.
2) Tenant-scoped extended TTL (customer addendum): 180-day TTL for a named tenant. Requires either Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private (VPC) for isolated retention settings. Controls we provide:
   - Tenant-scoped storage partitioning + KV cache scoping
   - Optional KMS-managed keys with customer-rotation policy (HSM/KMS integration)
   - Monthly immutable deletion attestations (signed digest of deleted object IDs + deletion timestamps)
   - Auditor export: filtered deletion audit trail (CSV) and sample proof-of-delete package for a rolling window

What we typically require from the customer for option #2:
- Signed addendum specifying tenant identifier(s) and TTL.
- Commitment to Dedicated or Private (billing adjustment may apply).
- If the customer insists on customer-held key custody, we run a short onboarding to validate KMS integration.

Attachments I’m dropping with this reply: retention-options-summary.pdf (high-level choices + cost delta) and proof-of-delete-sample.txt (example of the monthly attestation format).

Next steps proposal:
- Jonas: can you confirm the technical feasibility for Mediflow to be on a tenant-scoped 180d TTL in our Dedicated pool and estimate timeline to enable?
- Neha: can you outline the SOC2 evidentiary artifacts we can commit to (attestation cadence, fields in the deletion export, retention config snapshot)?

John — happy to schedule a 30m call next week to walk Mediflow Security through the addendum and sample artefacts. Proposed times: Tue 7/15 10am PT or Wed 7/16 2pm PT.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mediflow — Clarify customer-scoped debug log lifecycle

Irene / Jonas — forwarding John’s note and Irene’s initial options. Quick comments inline and a draft MAP attached.

Comments:
- Evidence: we should offer (a) monthly signed deletion attestations (sha256 digest list + timestamp, stored in immutable object store), (b) one auditor-facing CSV export of deletion events per quarter with IAM logs, (c) runbook describing the deletion pipeline (k8s job + storage lifecycle).
- CAIQ mapping: we should map SIG items scoping logging & retention to SOC2 CC6 with cross-reference to our retention playbook and the sample artifacts. I’ll draft the CAIQ answer set for the customer and request that Jonas provide the exact column names we’ll export for the deletion CSV.

Action items:
- Jonas: confirm export column set and whether the deletion attestations can be signed with our platform key (or whether we can support customer-supplied key signing).
- Irene: please review the attached mediflow-map-draft.docx and the proposed language for the addendum (I flagged a clause about on-demand rekeying that may need product sign-off).

I can take point on drafting the final CAIQ mapping and the addendum text once we have Jonas’ export spec.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Operations | Redwood Inference

Irene — thanks, that is helpful and a good summary. We’re aligned on the ask: Mediflow is willing to move to Dedicated (or Private) for tenant-scoped 180d traces if Redwood will provide the following as contractual deliverables:
1) Monthly immutable deletion attestation (sha256 digest + deletion timestamp) for the tenant ID, signed by Redwood platform key.
2) Quarterly auditor CSV export that contains deleted object IDs, deletion timestamps, and the initiating job-id/actor.
3) A short addendum (1–2 pages) to include in our contract that names the tenant(s) and TTL and references the monthly attestation and quarterly export as evidence.

If Redwood can provide those three items, Mediflow can proceed to legal to prepare the addendum. Can you confirm that the attestation format in proof-of-delete-sample.txt is acceptable and whether you can host a CAIQ mapping doc for our auditors to review? Also please confirm cost delta for Dedicated enabling 180d.

We’d like to schedule a kickoff call — Wed 7/16 2pm PT works for our team.

Best,
John
